parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the entity. Currently, only the table type is supported. You can obtain the ID from the response of the ListTables operation.

parameters.name: MetaCollectionId
parameters.description: The ID of the collection object. You can obtain the ID from the response of the ListMetaCollections operation.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remarks when adding the entity to the collection. Currently, this parameter takes effect only for the album type.
